rationale: The agent executed an order-changing write without first confirming with the user, violating the stated policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Authentication is not clearly demonstrated in the conversation (no explicit confirmation of user identity beyond the user’s self-reported name/zip), and the agent provided specific refund and payment details without visible supporting tool results. Even if back-end lookups occurred, the absence of a confirmation step alone is sufficient to fail per policy.
